description: Search Pulsedive threat DB with a query. Uses the Pulsedive Explore query language (boolean field filters) to find indicators matching criteria like type, risk, feed, or threat. Example: pulsedive_explore({ q: "type=domain and risk=high", limit: 20, _apiKey: "your-key" })

q.description: Explore query, e.g. "type=domain and risk=high", "ioc=*.ru and threat=emotet"
